the following questions: What are audit tools and techniques and how do they enhance the quality of the internal audit function? how audit tools and techniques can be used to enhance internal audit engagements in South Africa.
the use of audit techniques and tools in South African internal audit function.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the use of the audit tool and techniques by the South African internal auditors is similar to that of internal auditors in developed regions, but with some differences.
internal auditors in the developed regions are more inclined to the use of audit techniques and tools than their counterparts in South Africa.
the use of audit techniques and tools is important to the success of the audit process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
internal auditors in developed regions use more audit tools and techniques than those of South Africa.
, internal auditors in developing economies are using audit tools and techniques that are similar to those of the developed regions.
internal audit functions use audit tools and technique similar to that of other regions and that the most preferred audit tools and techniques enhance the quality of audit process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
internal auditors need to be trained on the importance of audit tools and technique in the audit process.
, the internal audit profession should be more proactive and use audit tools and technique to improve the audit process.
internal auditors should not limit themselves to the use of audit techniques and tools that they are comfortable with.
